scope: Pragmatic near-zero application hot paths; no dependency patches or strict zero-allocation requirement.
changes: Reuse a metadata-only selector workspace, bounded to 1304 descriptors for this dataset. Returned trees are borrowed until the next selection; hysteresis split sets remain independent.
Lazily cache bounded tile and foliage keys; reuse label array slots and numeric shadow-fit keys; remove worker-pool copies and recursive request closures.

Stop settled label layout and occlusion queries. Resume on camera/projection, world data, streaming/active visibility, viewport/UI geometry, fonts, or selected-place changes, preserving round-robin phase.

selectorMicrobenchmark.limitations: Single Node/V8 component run with allocation sampling; excludes workspace construction. Not a renderer or FPS benchmark.

browserProfiling.conclusion: Mixed whole-renderer results, with substantially different frame cadence between captures. No broad allocation or FPS improvement claimed from these captures. Ten-Hz selection work amortizes over different frame counts. Three.js and N8AO remain prominent allocation sites.
browserProfiling.dataset: Same local dataset including separately uncommitted vegetation changes; data changes excluded from commit.

validation.differential: 24 selector cases, 32 pooled-selector transitions, 770 label frames including settled/invalidation, 120 navigation frames passed
validation.voxel: 1304 tiles, 344010 quads, 20000 query points, 100 rays and 8 selector views passed
validation.streaming: 451 coverage samples with zero failures; retry, rapid turns, eviction and context restoration passed
validation.shadows: 8 scenarios passed, no missed loading batches or browser errors
validation.ui: 5712 tile-gating comparisons and night-time F3/F4 checks passed with zero mismatches, page or WebGL errors
